title: Finite modules free at all primes are locally free on an affine cover
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $M$ be a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. If for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $A$ the localization $M_{\mathfrak p}$ is a finite free $A_{\mathfrak p}$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module], then there are finitely many elements $f_1,\ldots,f_n\in A$ generating the unit ideal such that each localization $M_{f_i}$ is a finite free $A_{f_i}$-module. Equivalently, the quasi-coherent sheaf $\widetilde M$ on $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme, lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] is finite locally free.
